bankParse: {file}: invalid JSON. Check commas, quotes, and brackets.
bankEmpty: expected a nonempty array of questions.
bankId: ID must be a unique safe integer within this bank.
bankQuestion: question must be nonblank text or a nonempty array of text/code blocks.
bankOptions: options must contain at least two nonblank strings.
bankAnswer: answer must be an integer from 1 to the number of options.
bankQuestionBlock: question block {block} must have type "text" with nonblank text, or type "code" with nonblank code.
